name: Paris
summary: Choose one major museum per day and build walks along the Seine around it. Timed tickets and geographic grouping save more time than trying to cross the city repeatedly.
seasonNote: Summer and school holidays are busy; winter can suit museums but has shorter daylight.
arrival: CDG and Orly have different train and metro connections; check the correct airport fare and line.
gettingAround: Use metro and RER for longer journeys and walk neighbourhood clusters. Allow for station stairs.
cashTip: Cards are common; keep a little EUR cash for markets. Do not carry a whole trip budget in cash.
foodTip: Try a boulangerie breakfast, crêpes and neighbourhood bistros; compare set menus.
buyTip: Look for books, food gifts and independent design; confirm tax-refund eligibility before expensive shopping.
baseArea: A central neighbourhood near a useful metro connection

connections.note: Approximate train time; mandatory station check-in and border formalities add time.
